summary: Reorders, swaps, replaces, duplicates, or deletes rows and columns from an input table using names, indices, or a specified order list.

key_params.name: reorder
key_params.note: Choose whether rows or columns are processed

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: Reverse, replace, swap, or copy in specified order

key_params.name: before
key_params.note: Rows or columns copied, swapped, or replaced from

key_params.name: after
key_params.note: Rows or columns copied, swapped, or replaced to

key_params.name: order
key_params.note: Explicit row or column order for specified-order modes

key_params.name: delete
key_params.note: Delete unspecified rows or columns in specified-order modes

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Specified-order modes can duplicate rows or columns by listing the same name or index more than once.
Rows or columns not listed are appended in input order unless Delete Unspecified is enabled.
Name-based replacement and swap depend on stable header/label cells; index-based modes drift if upstream table shape changes.
Input must be table-shaped; free-form text should be converted before planning row/column reordering.
key_concepts: Reorders DAT rows or columns from an input table.
Method, Before, After, and Order parameters define explicit or relative reorder behavior.
Delete controls whether rows or columns outside the reordered set are removed.
Generated table tools should preserve intended headers when reordering row or column data.
